fatal_blockers: The fixed 18-survivor private-row construction is defeated throughout the tested two-clause scope by nonzero kernel moves of squared norm at most 4. Reusing or amplifying that unchanged gadget cannot restore local isolation.

Fable makes the proposed mutation search finitely bounded, curing the prior experiment-specification objection, but bounded enumeration only through squared norm 8 cannot certify that every nonzero integer kernel move changes every marginal. Such a claim requires complete circuit/Graver enumeration or a proved norm bound.

Passing a two-clause search through norm 8 would only exclude short moves in those compositions. It would not certify arbitrary multi-clause composition, where globally coupled marginal shifts and larger joint moves remain possible.

No amplification or dimension-dependent gap mechanism is supplied. Even successful local and two-clause tests would establish only finite constant-gap behavior, with no full-rank CVP basis, target, completeness radius, soundness threshold, or n^c gap.

The evidence does not independently establish provenance for the 18 survivors: SOL_RESULT claims a successful affine-isolation rerun, but no corresponding execution record is supplied. The overlap verifier's self-reconstruction and hardcoded hash are not independent verification.

Any claim that all private-row or occurrence-coupled compositions are impossible would exceed the evidence. The verifier covers two clauses sharing one or two variables while freeing unshared marginals, not globally constrained occurrence systems.
evidence: The reported overlap verifier covers 5,832 systems and 95,256 compatible references and finds a nonzero move of squared norm at most 4 in every covered system. The displayed move [-1,0,1,1,-1,0,0] satisfies the stated normalization, private-row, and shared-marginal equations.
A clause-one-supported witness suffices to refute isolation in each tested system, although the restricted search does not characterize the full kernel or globally coupled constructions.

Fable explicitly concedes that local all-marginal change need not survive composition because two clauses may compensate shared shifts. It also concedes that no amplification or dimension-gap mechanism exists after five generations.
The packet consistently labels the result FINITE and disclaims asymptotic hardness. That qualification is supported; no stronger conclusion is.

Fable's concrete limits—up to 12 columns, four rows, degree two, and norm eight—make a bounded search executable, but do not turn its negative bounded search into a universal impossibility certificate or its positive result into an asymptotic mechanism.
next_experiment: None for the current candidate. Reopen only as a mutated run after supplying both a complete kernel-certification method beyond a norm cutoff and a stated amplification law; then perform the bounded local-block and joint two-clause search under fixed row, column, degree, and coefficient limits.
